correctness.rationale: Complete standard-library executable rebuilds 2635 simplices and 8980 directed face incidences, proves acyclic matching with 1274 pairs and 34 degree-two/53 degree-three critical cells. Exact signed Morse integer boundary has 33 unimodular pivots and residual gcd 2, yielding the full attaching-map Smith form and Moore-space plus 19 three-spheres. Independent unreduced F2/F3/F5 ranks and eight signed Lefschetz traces check calculation. This is an exhaustive finite proof, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: Six is a mathematically motivated sharp onset of integral torsion for an established naturally ordered family of chessboard packing complexes; the degree-two Moore attachment detects structure unseen by rank/face counts and obstructs every sphere-wedge homotopy type. The D4 character adds genuine symmetry information and one invariant line. The classification has complete 6x6 homotopy content rather than arbitrary slicing or a routine rank gain.
